items.text: Christin Behrend: studied at Middlesex University, London (1997); taught art in Stuttgart 2001 to 2019; solo shows in Rome (2022) and Genoa (2023); Atlante Arte Contemporanea 2024, Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
Franca Fabrizio: self-taught painter; debut at PaviArt 2022; Triennale 2023, Rome; solo shows in Vienna, Paris, Rome, Alzano, Aosta

Yang Yexin: born 1973, Zhejiang; graduated Xi'an Academy of Fine Arts 1997; performance artist; solo shows Red Traces (Art Museum of Nanjing University of the Arts, 2026), Golden Grains Rush (CAFA Art Museum, Beijing, 2025), Traces or Track (Ulisse Gallery, Rome, 2024)
